description: React functional component 'ContentFilterConfiguration' managing patterns, keywords, categories, and file uploads for content filtering in the UI.

methods.name: handleAddPrebuiltPattern
methods.description: Adds a selected prebuilt pattern to the list.

methods.name: handleAddCustomPattern
methods.description: Adds a custom regex pattern to the list.

methods.name: handleAddKeyword
methods.description: Adds a new blocked keyword to the list.

methods.name: handleFileUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading and validation of a YAML file containing blocked words.
